headline.text: 2 accounts trading (Zlarior 50K, ATLAS 25K): about $1,180 a month once funded at the Jul-Oct 2026 rate (estimate; -$9 in a 2021-25-like market). Next step: Funded at MFFU, when an eval passes ($53,000 / $26,500).

items.title: Step 0: Pass the two live MFFU evals (3 accounts)
items.detail: When: now. Buy: nothing: Zlarior 50K and ATLAS 25K are trading, BLITZ 25K on paper. $0 a month until an eval passes.

items.title: Step 1: Funded at MFFU (3 accounts)
items.detail: When: an eval passes ($53,000 / $26,500). Buy: nothing: switch the passed account to funded; a failed eval is bought again the next day, unless the account is 5 eval prices below its best (the stop rule). First-year estimate about $1,629 a month (Jul-Oct 2026 rate), -$12 in a 2021-25 market.

items.title: Step 2: Two LIT 50K copies at Lucid / FundedNext (5 accounts)
items.detail: When: the first payout is in your bank AND each firm said yes to bots + copying your own accounts in writing. Buy: LucidPro 50K (about $115-135 with a code such as DGT / PFD, $192 list) + FundedNext Rapid 50K (about $160-200 list, codes claim 30-55% off), a week apart; Black Friday week (from about Nov 19) is the cheapest time. First-year estimate about $3,221 a month (Jul-Oct 2026 rate), -$53 in a 2021-25 market.

items.title: Step 3: Ten accounts (10 accounts)
items.detail: When: $10,000 net paid out, no funded account lost in the last 2 weeks. Buy: 4 more LucidPro 50K (Lucid's cap is 5 funded) + 1 more FundedNext 50K, one a week. First-year estimate about $6,886 a month (Jul-Oct 2026 rate), -$148 in a 2021-25 market.

items.title: Step 4: Your own live account (10 accounts)
items.detail: When: $30,000 kept after tax AND 3 months of live fills within the backtest's band. Buy: open a personal futures account with $25,000; LIT at 1% of the account per trade (MNQ micros). The 10 prop accounts keep paying; with this account, $1M within 5 years on 85% of Jul-Oct-2026-like paths (median 52 months), 0% in a 2021-25 market: possible if the edge holds, not a forecast.

notes: Estimates from backtests: H1 = Jan-Jun 2026 (picked), H2 = Jul-Oct 2026 (checked, the one to quote), REF = 2021-25, where LIT shows no edge (profit factor 1.01). Backtests overstate; nothing here is promised.
All LIT copies are one bet: in a bad month they lose together. Each account can only lose its eval price, never more.

Eval sizing (research/writeups/eval-guard-2026-11-13.md, a proposal, the owner decides): risking 40% of the room instead of 80% fails a fresh eval in 2 weeks about 1 time in 200 instead of 1 in 4 and is worth about $835-1,000 more per eval. This plan uses today's live sizing.
Firm rules change: ask each firm in writing about bots and copying your own accounts before buying (MFFU has not said yes to copies).
Not tax advice: prop payouts are usually contractor income; a personal futures account is taxed 60/40 (Section 1256). Ask a tax professional.
Account drawdown figures are from the last PC report (2026-11-07, 2026-11-12).

stop_rules: An account whose own running net is 5 eval prices below its best (about $460 on a 50K) buys no more evals: that is what a 2021-25-like market looks like, and it cuts the eval cash a bad market eats by over 90% and costs about 1-3% in a good one.
Live results 30 trades behind the backtest (profit factor under 1.0): buy no new evals until it recovers.
Never more than $3,000 at risk at the same time over all accounts; never long on one account and short on another.
Keep 30% of every payout for tax; only spend from what is left.
